purpose: Defines the common shape for centralized system units that will eventually absorb live reads from probe-era datasets.

fieldGuide.dataset: Format id for the system-unit instance file.
fieldGuide.unitId: Matches one migration unit id from data-framework.v1.json.
fieldGuide.systemId: Stable system identifier used by app, trace, and planner rewiring work.
fieldGuide.status: Lifecycle status for the centralized system unit.
fieldGuide.kind: Whether the unit describes an in-game system or a tooling/orchestration surface.
fieldGuide.schemaRef: Path to this shared format file.
fieldGuide.frameworkRef: Path to the framework manifest that owns the unit id.
fieldGuide.summary: Short human-readable statement of what the unit is for.
fieldGuide.liveConsumers: Known app, trace, or planner consumers that should eventually read the unit instead of individual files.
fieldGuide.subsystems: Named internal slices of the system that previously lived as separate datasets or migration units.
fieldGuide.provenance: Describes how embedded or future centralized data should trace back to committed sources or transient regeneration commands.
fieldGuide.views: Role-partitioned aggregated inputs grouped by intended use.
fieldGuide.targetShapeKeys: The final generated-unit shape. Units should collapse embedded data into canonical, boundaries, models, support, and traceEvidence instead of only listing source files or narrow sections.
fieldGuide.replacementPlan: Declares current seed outputs, expected projections, source material, archive review decisions, and what must happen before old files can be archived.

archiveReviewGuide.keep: The source still carries distinct model, calibration, or boundary value and should remain first-class.
archiveReviewGuide.defer: The source is not a live consumer input anymore, but archiving it now risks losing provenance or contradicting newer centralized views.
archiveReviewGuide.archive-candidate: The source is no longer needed as a live dataset once the listed replacement conditions hold.
